notes.note: Admins can enforce sign in with company credentials after a browser crash, preventing access to a restored browser session without authentication.
Added SBOM (Software Bill of Materials) generation to Firefox Enterprise builds.
Repeated failures to fetch remote policies are now logged in `about:policies` only when the error changes, reducing duplicate entries.
The SkipTermsOfUse policy is re-enabled on Enterprise builds.
Form ML is now disabled on enterprise releases by default.
Fixed an issue where the language switcher may have been visible in localized builds.
Fixed an issue where missing configuration files prevented Firefox Enterprise from updating to a newer version.
Fixed the Access Connector icon disappearing when Firefox displays a site's content in its built-in JSON or PDF viewer.
Fixed an issue where enabling a DLP file download rule caused the fallback action to apply to all downloads, regardless of the configured domains.

system_requirements:
**Prerequisites:** To use the Firefox Enterprise browser, your organization must first deploy the Admin Console on its own infrastructure. [Request early access][1] to get started.

## Windows

### Operating Systems (64-bit)
 - Windows 10 or later

### Recommended Hardware
-  1 gigahertz (GHz) or faster compatible processor or System on a Chip (SoC)
-  2GB of RAM
-  500MB of hard drive space

---

## Mac

### Operating Systems
- macOS 10.15 or later 

### Recommended Hardware
- Macintosh computer with an Intel x86 or Apple silicon processor
- 512 MB of RAM
- 200 MB hard drive space

---

## GNU/Linux

### Software Requirements

*Please note that GNU/Linux distributors may provide packages for your distribution which have different requirements.*

- Firefox will not run at all without the following libraries or packages:
    - glibc 2.17 or higher (glibc 2.28 or higher on arm64)
    - GTK+ 3.14 or higher
    - libglib 2.42 or higher
    - libstdc++ 4.8.1 or higher (libstdc++ 6.0 or higher on arm64)
    - X.Org 1.0 or higher (1.7 or higher is recommended)
- For optimal functionality, we recommend the following libraries or packages:
    - DBus 1.0 or higher
    - NetworkManager 0.7 or higher
    - PulseAudio

  [1]: https://www.firefox.com/enterprise/contact/
